meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'well; come on', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: Oh, come on, Dad!
Well?

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нимать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to understand', paired with 'понять'.

examples.trans: I understand.
I want to go to the sea, you know?

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'этому').

I'm tired, so I'm at home.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.trans: She was the one who met me! She circled around me like a shark.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to see', paired with 'увидеть'.

получаться.gloss: to work out, to come out

meanings.en: to work out, to come out
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лучаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to work out, to come out', paired with 'получиться'.

examples.trans: I can't manage it.
